en.headline: 3 own commits plus 7 automated; opened openchamber issue #4537
en.summary: On 2026-10-08, `sogeisetsu` made **3 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, plus 7 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. The own commits covered a watchdog token BOM-stripping fallback with a secret-handling note, a new Cloudflare Worker watchdog daily-report scheduler, and a CI cron tweak that avoids the top of the hour and adds a same-repo push fallback trigger. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded. In `openchamber/openchamber`, the user opened issue #4537, "[Bug] OpenCode Go quota shows 'Provider not configured' while the Providers page shows an API key for it", and then added two follow-up comments on the same issue. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied once on #4537, marking it `fix-ready` and confirming the two surfaces resolve OpenCode Go credentials differently on current main. Totals for the day: 3 commits, 0 PRs, 3 issues, 0 reviews.
